versions.subject: Auditd rule - Systemd Service Creation
versions.detection:
path:
  type: 'PATH'
  nametype: 'CREATE'
  name: 
       - '/usr/lib/systemd/system/*'
       - '*/.config/systemd/user/*'
       - '/etc/systemd/system/*'
condition: path
